text:
Asha (Finance): FYI — Brightleaf just pinged support, saying their monthly invoice looks 2x what they expected. Can someone grab the bill and confirm?
Kira (Acct Mgmt): Ugh, saw that. They attached invoice INV-2026-0042 and said spikes started 03/04. Quote: 'looks like duplicated ingestion events' :grimacing:
Mike (SRE): I can check logs, might be the ingestion partition bump we rolled out as part of the pricing-experiment. Will pull logs for their org id brt-998.
Tom (Billing Ops): If it's a platform duplication, we should issue a manual credit and block re-billing until we confirm root cause. Do we have a quick estimate of the overcharge?
Kira (Acct Mgmt): Customer says invoice was $12,430 vs expected ~$6,200. So ~6.2k overcharge.
Asha (Finance): OK. Need trace and a ticket for the credit. Mike, can you confirm whether duplicate requests generated double tokens? If so, we'll create a goodwill/manual adjustment.
Mike (SRE): Checked traces for brt-998. Found a window 2026-03-04 02:12–02:31 UTC where ingestion-worker retried a batch twice due to a transient DB timeout. Duplicate writes caused re-ingest; token counts doubled for ~19 mins.
Mike (SRE): Relevant logs snippet:
```
2026-03-04T02:13:05Z ingestion-worker brt-998 batch=3124 status=retry reason=DBTimeout seq_start=1024 seq_end=2047
2026-03-04T02:13:06Z ingestion-worker brt-998 batch=3124 status=success seq_start=1024 seq_end=2047
2026-03-04T02:28:19Z ingestion-worker brt-998 batch=3125 status=success seq_start=2048 seq_end=3071
```
Kira (Acct Mgmt): That aligns with their reported window. Looks like ~19 mins of double counting — thanks Mike.
Asha (Finance): Great. Tom, please prepare manual credit for ~6,230 USD, reference invoice INV-2026-0042 and note 'dup ingestion due to transient retry bug'. Use adjustment code MAN-CREDIT.
Tom (Billing Ops): Will do. Creating ticket now in BillingOps (#BILL-4127) and scheduling the credit. Command I will run in VaultBilling: 
```
vb credit --acct brt-998 --amount 6230 --currency USD --invoice INV-2026-0042 --code MAN-CREDIT --note "dup ingestion retry, 2026-03-04"
```
Asha (Finance): Please hold until Kira signs off on outreach message. We prefer to send a short note + credit confirmation to the customer before it appears on their next invoice.
Kira (Acct Mgmt): Drafted message: 
"Hi — we investigated and found duplicated ingestion events during 03/04 that caused inflated usage on INV-2026-0042. We've applied a manual credit of $6,230 (MAN-CREDIT). The credit will appear on your next statement. We're sorry for the disruption and have fixed the transient retry path. —Kira"
Tom (Billing Ops): Thanks, Kira. I queued the credit and put it in pending state until you approve. BILL-4127 notes updated.
billing-bot: Action queued: manual_credit_pending | id=BILL-4127 | acct=brt-998 | amt=6230 USD
Asha (Finance): Approving the credit. Proceed, Tom. Please tag finance when the credit posts.
Tom (Billing Ops): Running command now.
billing-bot: Action started: manual_credit | id=BILL-4127 | status=in_progress
billing-bot: Action completed: manual_credit | id=BILL-4127 | status=completed | txn=CR-2026-78A9
Tom (Billing Ops): Credit posted txn CR-2026-78A9. Updated invoice INV-2026-0042 with credit line.
Kira (Acct Mgmt): Sent customer note and CC'd finance. Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick fix and the credit." :thumbsup:
Asha (Finance): Closing this in Finance after reconciling ledger entry. Tom, can you add the root cause tag so we can track pricing-experiment regressions? (rc=pricing-exp-retry-dup)
